## The project

ZenoSolver computes the exact Pareto fronts, cost against makespan, of MultiZenoTravel
multi-objective planning instances, and proves them. It consists of the solver `zeno`, the theory
note
[`doc/theory/exact-front.md`](https://github.com/aquemy/ZenoSolver/blob/master/doc/theory/exact-front.md),
the Lean 4 formalization in `lean/`, the certificate format and its two checkers, the benchmarks
and the experiments. All are the work of **Alexandre Quemy**, in the repository
[`aquemy/ZenoSolver`](https://github.com/aquemy/ZenoSolver).

## Honesty: what is proved, and how {#honesty}

{{< include _blueprint-stats.md >}}

The blueprint's badges are computed when the site is built, from `collectAxioms` on the Lean
declarations each node lists. A node is badged machine-checked only if the declarations that
formalise its **whole** statement are axiom-clean theorems. Declarations covering only part of a
statement are listed under it, with their own badges, and the node keeps the note's status. The
generator stops if a declaration is missing or a label is not found in the note. The same badges
appear next to every theorem cited in the [paper](paper/index.qmd).

The compiled tools add trust in the Lean compiler and in an unverified parser
([trust base](solver/lean.qmd#trust)).

## This website

Built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) from `site/` into `docs/`
([how](solver/install.qmd#this-website)). Generated, never typed by hand:

- the blueprint, from `site/blueprint.toml`, the theory note and the Lean sources
  (`site/gen_blueprint.py`);
- the result tables, from the committed benchmark baselines (`site/gen_pages.py`);
- the claim graph and its history, from the knowledge commits and `claims.toml`
  (`site/gen_graph.py`);
- the plans of the [problem page](problem.qmd), the [instance fronts](instances/index.qmd) and the
  figures of the [algorithm page](solver/algorithm.qmd), computed with `zeno`
  (`site/gen_problem.py`, `site/gen_fronts.py`, `site/gen_algorithm.py`).
